name: Muramite Citadel: Lower Prison
summary: A brutal detention level where Dragorn captives are held, tortured, and processed by Muramite Inquisitors.
description: The Lower Prison is the first layer of the Muramite Citadel’s detention complex. Cramped stone cells, Discord‑warded interrogation chambers, and fortified guard stations fill the area. Muramite Inquisitors conduct interrogations, while legionnaire jailers maintain order through violence. Dragorn captives are processed here before being sent to the Upper Prison or the Arena. The air is thick with suffering, arcane residue, and the hum of Discord wards.
